people.name: Matthew McKeller
people.description: Main character of the investigation. ADHD/possibly autistic. Very good at nonverbal/visual communication, data associations, and problem solving. Limited working memory. Previously drove for Uber. Working on education and software development businesses (Expanse EDU).
notes: Father arrested for selling meth and having a gun
Owes taxes - views as cheap loan
Cautious with data/privacy - uses Faraday bags, defensive equipment
Planning multiple businesses including education and software development
